intro: Shadowsong Shrine is a ruined hillside sanctuary situated in western Azshara, not far from the Ashenvale border. Haunted by the restless spirits of ancient Highborne, the site bears the illustrious name of the Shadowsong bloodline, though its true historical connection to them remains shrouded in mystery.

p: Perched upon a high hill overlooking the shattered lands of Azshara, the Shadowsong Shrine lies in ancient, overgrown ruin. Like much of the surrounding coast, it is plagued by the lingering apparitions of Highborne ghosts who wander among the fallen stonework, seeking to extinguish any mortal life that trespasses upon their domain. The shrine shares its name with two legendary figures of kaldorei history: Jarod Shadowsong, the reluctant general who led the night elf resistance during the War of the Ancients, and his sister Maiev, the unrelenting warden of Illidan Stormrage. Whether this sanctuary was erected in honor of their deeds or dates back to the family's standing before the Sundering is a secret lost to the ages.
